name: Ricardo Benavides
bio:
Ricardo Benavides always had a head for numbers. Growing up in Mexico City, he was fascinated by the complex financial models behind large corporations. After earning his degree in finance, he spent several years working for a major accounting firm, quickly rising through the ranks. However, his true passion was always motorsport. He began attending races as a child and dreamed of combining his financial expertise with his love for speed.

An opportunity arose when Hot Car Competições sought a new finance controller. Ricardo jumped at the chance, eager to bring his analytical skills to the team. He's known for his meticulous approach to budgeting, cost analysis, and financial forecasting. Ricardo believes that fiscal responsibility is crucial to success on the track. He is adamant that every expenditure must demonstrably contribute to improved performance. 

Ricardo is a tough negotiator but is also fiercely loyal. He is respected for his integrity and his commitment to ensuring that the team remains financially sound and competitive. He insists on rigorous transparency and accountability, earning him the trust of both the management and the drivers.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small calculator in his pocket.
Insists on reviewing every expense report, no matter how small.
Often uses motorsport analogies when explaining financial concepts.
